assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for an underlying cardiac arrhythmia.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with potential rhythm disturbances.
The service was denied under reason code PR-204.
The diagnoses are I49.9 and Z86.73.
